== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ジャワのキャンプ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ジャワを配備する際、自分のフォースを１消費するだけでよい。サンドクローラーがあればフォース不要。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja"></span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Jawa Camp]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. When deploying Jawas, you only need to spend 1 of your Force. If a Sandcrawler is present, no Force is required. Dark Side. The printed Dark Side game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is ジャワのキャンプ. Light does not say “here” or “from you only” as English does. Dark game-text box is blank. One Light Force icon and one Dark Force icon.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-tatooinejawacamp.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Jawa Camp]].</ref>
